title: Big Rusty Drums (Karoryfer Samples)
description: Close microphones, medium velocity, first round robin of each drum.
author: Karoryfer Samples

title: Black and Blue Basses (Karoryfer Samples), Baby Blue
description: Baby Blue electric bass, regular playing, forte, first round robin; one file per note. Also darkblack: a darker, more aggressive bass from the same repo, chromatic across 25 notes, 4 dynamic layers (p/mp/mf/f, word-labelled so mapped by hand like Growlybass), round robin.
author: Karoryfer Samples

title: Black and Green Guitars (Karoryfer Samples)
description: The green guitar, ordinary playing, mezzo-forte, first round robin; one file per note.
author: Karoryfer Samples

title: Emily guitar (Karoryfer Samples)
description: Epiphone Emily the Strange electric guitar, mezzo-forte, first round robin; one file per note.
author: D. Smolken (played and mapped), Karoryfer Samples

title: Frankensnare (Karoryfer Samples)
description: A dedicated snare collection (many sizes/types); this set is the 14" type-A snare's basic hit, top mic, full depth (11 velocity layers x 4 round robins) - a tight, modern snare to layer over or swap into another kit for a punchier hit.
author: Karoryfer Samples

title: Growlybass (Karoryfer Samples)
description: An aggressive bass for the low end under a metal guitar. Dynamics are dynamic-mark folders (pp/p/f/ff), not numeric velocity, so 4 separate rules map them to layers 1-4 by hand; 4 round robins each, 7 notes (a2 c3 e2 a3 c4 a4 c5).
author: Karoryfer Samples

title: Headroom Piano
license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0): free to use, also commercially, when you credit the author
description: Close microphones, level 3 of 5, one file per third note.
author: Bengt Nilsson

title: Meatbass double bass (Karoryfer Samples)
description: Pizzicato, second velocity layer, first round robin; one file per note. "pizzicato-deep" is the same articulation with full depth (4 velocity layers x 4 round robins) instead.
author: Drogomir Smolken (played), Ludwik Zamenhof (recorded), Karoryfer Samples

title: Naked Drums (Wilkinson Audio)
description: A large multi-mic ARIA-SFZ kit built from nested #include/#define macros, not a plain filename scheme; its round robins are spelled as words (one..ten) with 3 unexplained hash-suffixed takes each, which does not fit this tool's numeric round-robin extraction. Took velocity depth only (5 layers, round robin 'one'): close/bottom mic kick, close-room mic snare, dedicated hi-hat mic. The full kit also has far more pieces (toms, multiple cymbals, several room/overhead mic blends) left unmapped.
author: Wilkinson Audio

title: Osiris Piano
description: Upright piano, sustain, noisy variant, microphone A, second velocity layer; one file per natural note.
author: Osiris Piano (sfzinstruments)

title: Salamander Grand Piano V3
license: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported (CC BY 3.0): free to use, also commercially, when you credit the author
description: Velocity layer 8 of 16, one file per minor third; AMPLE moves the nearest sample to the note that is played.
author: Alexander Holm

title: Shinyguitar (Karoryfer Samples)
description: A second electric guitar tone, distinct from Black and Green Guitars and Emily Guitar - sparse note sampling (9 notes, major-third spacing: a2 c3 e2 a3 c4 a4 c5 a5 c6), but full velocity/round-robin depth (4 layers x 4 RR) per note. Also has an 'acoustic' set from the same repo.
author: Karoryfer Samples

title: Swirly Drums (Karoryfer Samples)
description: A world-percussion/extended-cymbal kit, not a standard acoustic rock kick (no plain kick, only cajon/marching/buzz variants): cajon kick front mic (13x4), snare top mic (12x4), closed hat (12x4), open hat (14x4), crash (12x4), ride (15x4), djembe (12x4). Use as a percussion layer, not a full metal kit.
author: Karoryfer Samples

title: The Hat With The Phat (Karoryfer Samples)
description: A dedicated 20" hi-hat with more articulations than a usual kit's hi-hat: closed edge (4 layers x 4 RR) and open bow (5 layers x 4 RR), both default branch is master not main.
author: Karoryfer Samples

title: Unruly Drums (Karoryfer Samples)
description: Main close/out mic per piece, full velocity layers and round robins of the natural (non-brush, non-choke) hit: kick out/clean (8 layers x 4 RR), snare top/center (8x4), hi-hat close mic tip (7x4 closed and open), crash close mic bow (5x4), ride close mic bow (8x4). No toms in this kit.
author: Karoryfer Samples

title: Virtuosity Drums (jazz kit)
description: Middle microphone. Snare and toms: velocity layer 8 of 16; kick, hi-hat, ride and crash: layer 3 of 4, first round robin.
author: Austin McMahon (drums), Virtuosity Musical Instruments, Boston

title: VSCO 2 Community Edition (Versilian Studios)
license: CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication, from the LICENSE file of the repository)
description: Upright piano (dynamic layer 2 of 3, first round robin) and violin ensemble pizzicato (velocity 2). Credit to the authors is encouraged, not required.
author: Versilian Studios LLC; the upright piano was sampled by Simon Dalzell of Ivy Audio
